Disappointing Experience

I recently stayed in this accommodation and was disappointed with the overall quality. The rooms are compact and lack proper maintenance. Unfortunately, the fridge and AC were not functioning during my stay.

The room's furnishings, including the door, cupboard, and bed, were of poor quality. The washroom was also not clean.

Additionally, there are no nearby amenities, such as tea or food stalls.

Based on my experience, I would advise others to explore alternative opti
ons for accommodation.

Please note that I've removed some of the more confrontational language to make the review more constructive and helpful.
